jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% for 6 months (with the potential to convert to a full-time position) Start date : from September 2025 onwards Help our clients making investment or divestment decisions Launch your career in our Strategy & Transaction team. We offer our clients advice on mergers & acquisitions, transactions, company valuations and restructuring. We are currently looking for a trainee to join the Transaction Services team. By joining our team you can actively support clients on analysing and assessing information to help them make decisions and realize the added value of their M&A transactions as sellers and buyers. Your work will impact the pricing and execution of M&A transactions. How you can make an impact
• You will have the opportunity to analyse financial statements, company reports and other financial information on companies from various sectors - on your own and in teams
• You can actively contribute to drafting client deliverables (Powerpoint and Excel) for senior executives and decision-makers, with increasing responsibility
• You will leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance the depth, efficiency and quality of your analysis, helping the team generate sharper insights
• You will learn to have attention to detail without losing sight of the big picture
• You will have the chance to positively contribute to the team spirit with your down-to-earth attitude and sky-high motivation Who we are looking for
• Motivation to work under pressure and with short deadlines
• Nearing the end of your Master’s degree in Finance, Banking, Accounting and/or MBA
• Previous internships (and/or work experience) in M&A, Investment Banking, Audit, Private Equity, Finance & Control etc. are highly appreciated
• Experience in due diligence projects and/or analysis of the balance sheets, cash flow, income statements and strong excel skills and experience with handling large financial datasets (e.g. using Alteryx) is an advantage
• English & German are mandatory. Any additional languages would be a strong advantage Your team Our Transaction Services team gives advice for buyers and sellers ranging from small and medium sized enterprises, to large multinational corporations and private equity firms in their evaluation of potential transactions. We look forward to having you as part of our team! We offer an opportunity to learn something new every day in a supportive, low-hierarchy and highly collaborative environment. We are a 40+ team of professionals from various countries helping to add real value to our clients. The office language is predominantly English and we appreciate diversity in all its forms. We will help you grow as a professional via training, coaching and many other continuous development opportunities. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Lucrezia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. © 2026. For information, contact Deloitte AG. All rights reserved. descriptionByLocale.it:
Offriamo con orgoglio:
• Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.
• Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Percentuale: 80-100% per 6 mesi (con il potenziale di conversione in una posizione a tempo pieno) Data d'inizio: da settembre 2025 in poi Aiuta i nostri clienti a prendere decisioni di investimento o di immersione Avviare la tua carriera nel nostro team di Strategia & Transazione. Offriamo ai nostri clienti consulenza su fusioni e acquisizioni, transazioni, valutazioni aziendali e ristrutturazioni. Stiamo attualmente cercando un apprendista per aderire al team Transaction Services. Unendo il nostro team è possibile supportare attivamente i clienti nell'analisi e nella valutazione delle informazioni per aiutarli a prendere decisioni e realizzare il valore aggiunto delle loro transazioni M&A come venditori e acquirenti. Il vostro lavoro influenzerà i prezzi e l'esecuzione delle transazioni M&A. Come si può fare un impatto
• Avrete l'opportunità di analizzare i bilanci, le relazioni aziendali e altre informazioni finanziarie su aziende di vari settori - da soli e in team
• È possibile contribuire attivamente alla redazione di client deliverables (Powerpoint e Excel) per dirigenti senior e decisori, con crescente responsabilità
• Potrai sfruttare gli strumenti AI-enabled per migliorare la profondità, l'efficienza e la qualità della tua analisi, aiutando il team a generare approfondimenti più nitidi
• Imparerai ad avere attenzione ai dettagli senza perdere di vista il grande quadro
• Avrete la possibilità di contribuire positivamente allo spirito di squadra con il vostro atteggiamento verso il basso verso la terra e la motivazione cielo-alto Chi stiamo cercando
• Motivazione al lavoro sotto pressione e con scadenze brevi
• Alla fine del Master in Finanza, Banca, Contabilità e/o MBA
• Gli stage precedenti (e/o l'esperienza lavorativa) in M&A, Investment Banking, Audit, Private Equity, Finance & Control ecc sono molto apprezzati.
• L'esperienza nei progetti di due diligence e/o l'analisi dei bilanci, del flusso di cassa, dei rendimenti e delle forti capacità di eccellere e dell'esperienza con la gestione di grandi dataset finanziari (ad es. utilizzando Alteryx) è un vantaggio
• Inglese e tedesco sono obbligatori. Qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva sarebbe un forte vantaggio Il nostro team di Transaction Services fornisce consigli per acquirenti e venditori che vanno da piccole e medie imprese, a grandi multinazionali e imprese private di equity nella loro valutazione di potenziali transazioni. Non vediamo l'ora di averti come parte della nostra squadra! Offriamo l'opportunità di imparare qualcosa di nuovo ogni giorno in un ambiente di supporto, bassa gerarchia e altamente collaborativo. Siamo un team di professionisti 40+ di vari paesi che contribuiscono ad aggiungere valore reale ai nostri clienti. La lingua ufficio è prevalentemente inglese e apprezziamo la diversità in tutte le sue forme. Vi aiuteremo a crescere come un professionista tramite formazione, coaching e molte altre opportunità di sviluppo continuo. Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori del settore. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità di connettersi, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visita www.apply.deloitte.ch Come applicare Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Lucrezia all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – applicare oggi. Non accettiamo richieste da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. © 2026. Per informazioni, contattare Deloitte AG. Tutti i diritti riservati. Deloitte AG è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità Requisition riferimento: 24053

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir bieten stolz:
• Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit null Toleranz für Belästigung.
• Offene Umgebungen, in denen Menschen frei sind, sie selbst zu sein.
• Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die an Respekt und Verdienst glaubt. Standort : Zurich Work Pattern Prozentsatz : 80-100% für 6 Monate (mit dem Potenzial, in eine Vollzeitstelle umzuwandeln) Startdatum: Ab September 2025 Helfen Sie unseren Kunden, Investitions- oder Desinvestitionsentscheidungen zu treffen Starten Sie Ihre Karriere in unserem Strategie- und Transaktionsteam. Wir bieten unseren Mandanten Beratung bei Mergers & Acquisitions, Transaktionen, Unternehmensbewertungen und Restrukturierungen. Wir sind derzeit auf der Suche nach einem Trainee für das Transaction Services Team. Indem Sie sich unserem Team anschließen, können Sie Kunden aktiv bei der Analyse und Bewertung von Informationen unterstützen, um ihnen zu helfen, Entscheidungen zu treffen und den Mehrwert ihrer M & A-Transaktionen als Verkäufer und Käufer zu realisieren. Ihre Arbeit wird sich auf die Preisgestaltung und Ausführung von M & A-Transaktionen auswirken. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen können
• Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Abschlüsse, Unternehmensberichte und andere Finanzinformationen zu Unternehmen aus verschiedenen Branchen zu analysieren - alleine und in Teams
• Sie können aktiv zur Erstellung von Kundenergebnissen (Powerpoint und Excel) für Führungskräfte und Entscheidungsträger mit zunehmender Verantwortung beitragen.
• Sie nutzen KI-fähige Tools, um die Tiefe, Effizienz und Qualität Ihrer Analyse zu verbessern und dem Team dabei zu helfen, schärfere Einblicke zu gewinnen
• Sie werden lernen, die Aufmerksamkeit auf das Detail zu haben, ohne das große Bild aus den Augen zu verlieren
• Sie haben die Chance, mit Ihrer bodenständigen Einstellung und himmelhohen Motivation einen positiven Beitrag zum Teamgeist zu leisten Wen wir suchen
• Motivation, unter Druck und mit kurzen Deadlines zu arbeiten
• Nahe dem Ende Ihres Master-Abschlusses in Finance, Banking, Accounting und / oder MBA
• Frühere Praktika (und / oder Berufserfahrung) in M & A, Investment Banking, Audit, Private Equity, Finance & Control usw. werden sehr geschätzt
• Erfahrung in Due-Diligence-Projekten und / oder Analysen der Bilanzen, des Cashflows, der Gewinn- und Verlustrechnungen sowie starke herausragende Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen im Umgang mit großen Finanzdatensätzen (z. B. mit Alteryx) sind von Vorteil
• Englisch & Deutsch sind obligatorisch. Alle zusätzlichen Sprachen wären ein großer Vorteil Ihr Team Unser Transaction Services Team berät Käufer und Verkäufer von kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen bis hin zu großen multinationalen Unternehmen und Private-Equity-Unternehmen bei der Bewertung potenzieller Transaktionen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie als Teil unseres Teams zu haben! Wir bieten die Möglichkeit, jeden Tag etwas Neues in einem unterstützenden, hierarchisch niedrigen und hochgradig kooperativen Umfeld zu lernen. Wir sind ein über 40-köpfiges Team von Fachleuten aus verschiedenen Ländern, das dazu beiträgt, unseren Kunden einen echten Mehrwert zu bieten. Die Bürosprache ist überwiegend Englisch und wir schätzen Vielfalt in all ihren Formen. Wir helfen Ihnen, als Profi durch Training, Coaching und viele andere kontinuierliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu wachsen. Karriere bei Deloitte. Wähle deine Wirkung. Bei Deloitte erzeugen Ihre Ideen Wirkung und bewirken bedeutende Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft. Ihre einzigartige Expertise, Ihr Hintergrund und Ihre Perspektive helfen uns, neue Wege in die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, damit wir die Zukunft derer, die unsere Arbeit beeinflusst, erhellen können. Bei Deloitte können Sie eine Karriere aufbauen, die Sie inspiriert und belebt. Bei Deloitte können Sie Ihre Wirkung auswählen. In der Schweiz erbringen wir branchenspezifische Dienstleistungen in den Bereichen Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory und Technology & Transformation. Mit knapp 3.000 Mitarbeitern an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Größe in allen Branchen. Wir bieten sinnvolle und herausfordernde Arbeit, ein integratives und unterstützendes Umfeld, in dem Sie Ihr bestes Selbst sein können und in dem Sie nie aufhören werden zu wachsen. Sie profitieren von flexiblen und hybriden Arbeitsbedingungen, Wohlbefinden und Elternprogrammen sowie vielen Möglichkeiten, sich zu verbinden, zusammenzuarbeiten und zu lernen. Schließen Sie sich uns an und werden Sie Teil eines globalen Netzwerks von Gleichgesinnten, die sich dafür einsetzen, etwas zu bewirken, sei es durch die Bekämpfung des Klimawandels oder die Verbesserung von 100 Millionen Futures bis 2030. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Lucrezia unter talent@deloitte.ch *Wir betrachten alle qualifizierten Bewerber für eine Beschäftigung unabhängig von Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, religiöser Überzeugung, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationaler Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung in Übereinstimmung mit geltendem Recht. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous offrons fièrement :
• Un lieu de travail sûr et une tolérance zéro pour le harcèlement.
• Des environnements ouverts où les gens sont libres d'être eux-mêmes.
• Une communauté inclusive qui croit au respect et au mérite. Lieu : Zurich Profil de travail Pourcentage : 80-100% pendant 6 mois (avec la possibilité de se convertir à un poste à temps plein) Date de début : à partir de septembre 2025 Aidez nos clients à prendre des décisions d'investissement ou de cession Lancez votre carrière dans notre équipe Stratégie & Transaction. Nous offrons des conseils à nos clients sur les fusions et acquisitions, les transactions, les évaluations d'entreprise et la restructuration. Nous cherchons actuellement un stagiaire pour rejoindre l'équipe des Services transactionnels. En vous joignant à notre équipe, vous pouvez soutenir activement les clients dans l'analyse et l'évaluation de l'information pour les aider à prendre des décisions et à réaliser la valeur ajoutée de leurs opérations de fusion et d'acquisition en tant que vendeurs et acheteurs. Votre travail aura une incidence sur le prix et l'exécution des opérations de fusion-acquisition. Comment faire un impact
• Vous aurez l'occasion d'analyser les états financiers, les rapports d'entreprise et d'autres informations financières sur les entreprises de différents secteurs - par vous-même et en équipe
• Vous pouvez contribuer activement à la rédaction des produits livrables des clients (Powerpoint et Excel) pour les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs, avec une responsabilité croissante
• Vous tirerez parti des outils compatibles avec l'IA pour améliorer la profondeur, l'efficacité et la qualité de votre analyse, aidant l'équipe à générer des informations plus précises
• Vous apprendrez à avoir l'attention au détail sans perdre de vue le grand tableau
• Vous aurez la chance de contribuer positivement à l'esprit d'équipe avec votre attitude de terre à terre et votre grande motivation Qui nous cherchons
• Motivation à travailler sous pression et dans des délais courts
• Vers la fin de votre maîtrise en finance, banque, comptabilité et/ou MBA
• Les stages antérieurs (et/ou l'expérience de travail) en M&A, Banque d'investissement, Audit, Private Equity, Finance & Control, etc. sont très appréciés.
• L'expérience des projets de diligence raisonnable et/ou de l'analyse des bilans, des flux de trésorerie, des états de résultat et des compétences et de l'expérience élevées en matière de traitement des grands ensembles de données financières (p. ex. l'utilisation d'Alteryx) est un avantage
• Anglais et allemand sont obligatoires. Toute autre langue serait un fort avantage Votre équipe Notre équipe de Services transactionnels donne des conseils aux acheteurs et aux vendeurs allant des petites et moyennes entreprises aux grandes multinationales et aux sociétés de capitaux privés dans leur évaluation des transactions potentielles. Nous avons hâte de vous accueillir dans notre équipe ! Nous offrons l'occasion d'apprendre quelque chose de nouveau chaque jour dans un environnement de soutien, de faible hiérarchie et de collaboration. Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 40 professionnels de différents pays qui contribuent à apporter une réelle valeur ajoutée à nos clients. La langue de bureau est principalement l'anglais et nous apprécions la diversité sous toutes ses formes. Nous vous aiderons à grandir en tant que professionnel par la formation, le coaching et de nombreuses autres possibilités de développement continu. Carrières chez Deloitte. Choisissez votre impact. Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos gens et notre société. Votre expertise, votre expérience et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles façons de relever les défis les plus complexes afin que nous puissions améliorer l'avenir de nos travaux. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous stimule. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez choisir votre impact. En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit et de l'assurance, de la fiscalité et du droit, de la stratégie, du conseil sur les risques et les transactions et de la technologie et de la transformation. Avec près de 3 000 employés sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et des organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs de l'industrie. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et solidaire où vous pouvez être votre meilleur moi et où vous n'arrêterez jamais de grandir. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail flexibles et hybrides, de programmes de bien-être et de programmes parentaux ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de connexion, de collaboration et d'apprentissage. Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'un réseau mondial de personnes partageant les mêmes idées et vouées à faire la différence, que ce soit en s'attaquant au changement climatique ou en améliorant 100 millions d'avenir d'ici 2030. Les recherches montrent que les femmes sont moins susceptibles de postuler pour des rôles à moins qu'elles ne correspondent à tous les critères ; ne vous retenez pas – postulez aujourd'hui. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Basel, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Start your career where Global Mobility meets real impact In Global Employer Services , we support internationally mobile employees and executives as they work across borders. Our work ensures that individuals sent on assignments abroad, relocating to Switzerland, or working in multiple countries remain compliant with tax and social security rules; both locally and internationally. You will focus on Swiss Individual Tax , working in a high-impact team to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet the complex needs of our global clients. Your responsibilities
• You will have the opportunity to take ownership from day one , to be involved in client-facing activities in the field of Swiss tax.
• You prepare Swiss tax declarations and analyze complex international tax and social security positions.
• You conduct research and prepare advice tailored to each client.

Your work will cover data modelling, data integration, transformation pipelines, DevOps, and use of AI to build and operate these platforms smartly. • Dimensional modelling
• Data Vault

Come si può fare un impatto Come un Data Architect nel nostro team AI & Data, aiuterà gli anziani ai nostri clienti a fare le scelte architettoniche giuste e condurre la progettazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni innovative a livello aziendale. Il vostro impatto sarà significativo nelle seguenti aree:
• Progettazione Enterprise Data Architecture: aiutare i clienti a modernizzare i paesaggi di sistema complessi che spaziano da soluzioni multiple (ad esempio, MDM, CRM, ERP, Cloud DWH) che devono essere integrati. Potrai lavorare con gli stakeholder dei clienti senior per progettare l'architettura a livello aziendale, gli standard di architettura pragmatico e esecutivo, e pianificare con loro il viaggio di modernizzazione.
• Progettazione e implementazione di Lead Cloud Data Platform: aiutare i clienti a costruire piattaforme dati cloud scalabili e ad alte prestazioni in grado di soddisfare le esigenze aziendali. Il vostro lavoro coprirà la modellazione dei dati, l'integrazione dei dati, le pipeline di trasformazione, DevOps, e l'uso di AI per costruire e gestire queste piattaforme in modo intelligente. Prenderai decisioni chiave di progettazione e guiderai team di ingegneria onshore, vicino/offshore che sviluppano la soluzione.
• Architetto Soluzioni Integrate: aiutare i clienti a progettare e costruire integrazioni necessarie per eseguire i loro processi aziendali e fornire prodotti di dati. Ciò può includere l'integrazione tra piattaforma di dati Cloud e piattaforma AI/Gen AI o tra sistemi MDM o CRM e piattaforma dati Cloud.
• Rafforzare il posizionamento del mercato e le opportunità imbuto: guidare la nostra impronta di architettura nel mercato attraverso eventi, conferenze e discussioni con i nostri clienti chiave, team interni e partner di alleanza.
• Sviluppa il nostro know-how e la nostra esperienza interna: i membri del team di mentore junior all'interno di AI & Data e impostare l'attenzione strategica per la costruzione di competenze all'interno della Svizzera e in relazione alle squadre vicine e offshore. Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Hai background ingegneristico e più esperienze di implementazione della piattaforma di dati pratico end-to-end come ingegnere di dati in passato (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake)
• Sei abile nella valutazione e/o nell'assunzione di decisioni sull'architettura dei dati, influenzando la direzione strategica e convincendo gli stakeholder aziendali e IT
• Siete abili nella guida di ingegneri di dati con le migliori pratiche in stili di codifica e qualità di codifica e hanno familiarità con strumenti di qualità di codifica industriale come SonarQube e assistenti di codifica AI integrati in IDE
• Hai esperienza in una gamma di tipi di database, tra cui modelli strutturati (relazionali), semi-strutturati (NoSQL) e basati su grafi (grafico di conoscenza).
• Bello da avere: hai esperienza nelle soluzioni della piattaforma di dati di imballaggio in Infrastructure come Code utilizzando soluzioni come Terraform
• Guida e motivazione:

• Keen interesse e capacità di rimanere in cima alla tecnologia e tendenze architettoniche
• Capacità di gestire più attività in un ambiente e interruttore di contesto ad alta velocità senza perdere fuoco o grande immagine
• Leadership, acume commerciale e capacità di comunicazione:

• Forte capacità di ragionamento astratto per afferrare il livello di impresa, il livello di soluzione e i concetti operativi e come si collegano insieme per formare una soluzione
• Forte capacità di comunicazione sia orale che scritta e la capacità di articolare chiaramente il punto di vista e risuonare con gli stakeholder tecnici e aziendali
• Forte capacità di leadership del team con la capacità di collaborare con gli esterni, valutare e pianificare il lavoro, e membri del team di coach per fornire risultati ottimali del cliente
• Competenza tecnica:
• Forti competenze nei metodi di modellazione con esperienza o certificazioni da DAMA, TOGAF o equivalente:
• Modelli di dati concettuali, logici e fisici
• Modelli dimensionali
• Scheda tecnica
• Progettazione di schemi normalizzati e denormalizzati per carichi di lavoro analitici e operativi e comprensione del kit strumenti di modellazione
• Esperienza pratica nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni sulle principali piattaforme cloud:
• Servizi web Amazone (AWS)
• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Azure

• Design E2E architetture che bilanciano prestazioni, costi e manutenbilità
• Stimolare lo sforzo di implementazione e i team di consegna dei lead

• Utilizzo delle capacità GenAI per ottimizzare la consegna e il funzionamento

• Metadati e architettura guidata eventi:

• Capacità di sfruttare i metadati per sviluppare la logica basata sugli eventi all'interno della pipeline per il monitoraggio e gli avvisi
• Enterprise Architectures con un forte focus sull'integrazione delle soluzioni MDM con piattaforme di dati e l'estensione della piattaforma dati con componenti AI Platform
• Quadri di programmazione e formati di dati:
• Possibilità di rivedere i lavori di ingegneria effettuati in SQL, Python, Spark
• Familiarità con database relazionali e NoSQL, grafici di conoscenza e grandi formati di file di dati (Parquet, Iceberg)
• Proficienza linguistica:
• Fluente in inglese; fluency in tedesco e/o francese è molto preferito Il vostro team Diventa parte di un team diversificato e multinazionale di 60+ persone altamente motivate che si trovano nei nostri uffici di Zurigo, Ginevra o Basilea. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. Location : Zurich, Basel, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% You bring ambition, we provide opportunities Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyse growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward. How you can make an impact As a Data Architect in our AI & Data team, you will help senior people at our clients to make the right architectural choices and lead the design and implementation of innovative enterprise-wide solutions. Your will be able to make significant impact in the following areas:
• Lead Enterprise Data Architecture design: help clients modernize complex system landscapes spanning multiple solutions (e.g., MDM, CRM, ERP, Cloud DWH) that need to be integrated. You will work with senior client stakeholders to design enterprise level architecture, pragmatic and enforceable architecture standards, and plan with them the modernization journey.
• Lead Cloud Data Platform design & implementation: help clients build scalable, high-performance Cloud data platforms that meet the business needs. Your work will cover data modelling, data integration, transformation pipelines, DevOps, and use of AI to build and operate these platforms smartly. You will make key design decisions and lead onshore, near-/offshore engineering teams developing the solution.
• Architect Integrated Solutions: help clients design and build integrations required to run their business processes and deliver data products. This may include integration between Cloud data platform and AI/Gen AI platform or between MDM or CRM systems and Cloud data platform.
• Strengthen our market positioning and opportunities funnel: lead our architecture footprint in the market through events, conferences, and discussions with our key clients, internal teams, and alliance partners.
• Develop our internal know-how and expertise: mentor junior team members within AI & Data and set strategic focus for expertise building within Switzerland and in relation to near- and offshore teams. What We Are Looking For:
• Experience:
• You have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience in the role of a Data Architect and have led teams that designed and implemented complex cloud-based ecosystems
• You have engineering background and multiple hands-on data platform end-to-end implementation experiences as a data engineer in the past (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake)
• You are proficient in evaluating and/or taking data architecture decisions, influencing strategic direction and convincing business and IT stakeholders
• You are proficient in guiding data engineers with best practices in coding styles and coding quality and are familiar with industrial coding quality tools such as SonarQube as well as AI coding assistants integrated into IDE
• You have experience across a range of database types, including structured (relational), semi-structured (NoSQL), and graph-based (knowledge graph) models.
• Nice to have: you have experience in packaging data platform solutions into Infrastructure as Code using solutions such as Terraform
• Drive and Motivation:
• Focused individuals looking to grow their careers on the path of becoming Senior Data Architect within AI & Data consulting
• Keen interest and ability to stay on top of technology and architectural trends
• Ability to manage multiple activities in a high-paced environment and context switch without losing focus or big picture
• Leadership, commercial acumen, and communication skills:
• Strong client-facing presence and ability to connect with different senior stakeholders, build relationships, and assess, expand and convert opportunities into projects
• Strong abstract reasoning skills to grasp enterprise level, solution level, and operational concepts and how they link together to form a solution
• Strong communications skills both oral and written and ability to clearly articulate point of view and resonate with technical and business stakeholders
• Strong team leadership skills with ability to partner with externals, estimate and plan the work, and coach team members to deliver optimal client outcomes
• Technical Expertise:
• Strong skills in modelling methods with experience or certifications from DAMA, TOGAF or equivalent:
• Conceptual, logical, and physical data models
• Dimensional modelling
• Data Vault
• Design of normalized and denormalized schemas for analytical and operational workloads and understanding of modelling toolkit
• Hands-on experience in designing and implementing solutions on major cloud platforms:
• Amazone Web Services (AWS)
• Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Azure
• Expertise in architecting modern data platforms (Lakehouse, Medallion, Lambda, event-driven) in Snowflake and/or Databricks, or equivalent
• Design E2E architectures that balance performance, cost, and maintainability
• Estimate implementation effort and lead delivery teams
• Create architecture blueprints and solution design documents
• Use of GenAI capabilities to optimize delivery and operation
• Data Integration & ETL
• Design integration layer architecture from multiple sources (ERP, CRM, operational databases, APIs, files)
• Nice to have: Familiarity with ETL/ELT such as Informatica or DBT
• Metadata and event-driven architecture:
• Expertise in metadata and event-driven architecture with the ability to articulate best practices for capturing metadata within a data pipeline
• Ability to leverage metadata to develop event-driven logic within the pipeline for monitoring and alerts
• Enterprise Architectures with strong focus of integrating MDM solutions with data platforms and extending data platform with AI Platform components
• Programming frameworks and data formats:
• Ability to review engineering work done in SQL, Python, Spark
• Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, knowledge graphs, and big data file formats (Parquet, Iceberg)
• Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 60+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich, Geneva, or Basel offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Notre rôle est de comprendre leurs problèmes d'affaires et d'utiliser la pensée et la technologie fondées sur les données pour obtenir des résultats qui stimulent leurs activités. Comment faire un impact En tant qu'architecte de données dans notre équipe d'IA & Data, vous aiderez les personnes âgées de nos clients à faire les bons choix architecturaux et à diriger la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Vous serez en mesure d'avoir un impact significatif dans les domaines suivants :
• Conception de l'architecture de données d'entreprise principale : aider les clients à moderniser des paysages de systèmes complexes couvrant plusieurs solutions (p. ex. MDM, CRM, ERP, Cloud DWH) qui doivent être intégrées. Vous travaillerez avec les principaux clients pour concevoir une architecture de niveau d'entreprise, des normes d'architecture pragmatiques et exécutoires, et planifier avec eux le parcours de modernisation.
• Conception et implémentation de la plate-forme de données Cloud Lead : aider les clients à construire des plateformes de données Cloud évolutives et performantes qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise. Votre travail couvrira la modélisation des données, l'intégration des données, les pipelines de transformation, DevOps, et l'utilisation de l'IA pour construire et exploiter ces plateformes intelligemment. Vous prendrez des décisions clés en matière de conception et dirigerez les équipes d'ingénierie à terre, près ou à terre, en développant la solution.
• Architect Integrated Solutions: aidez les clients à concevoir et à construire les intégrations nécessaires pour gérer leurs processus d'affaires et fournir des produits de données. Cela peut inclure l'intégration entre la plate-forme de données Cloud et la plate-forme AI/Gen AI ou entre les systèmes MDM ou CRM et la plate-forme de données Cloud.
• Renforcer notre positionnement sur le marché et nos opportunités entonnoir : diriger notre empreinte architecturale sur le marché par des événements, des conférences et des discussions avec nos clients clés, nos équipes internes et nos partenaires d'alliance.

• Vous avez des antécédents techniques et plusieurs expériences pratiques de mise en œuvre de la plate-forme de données en tant qu'ingénieur de données dans le passé (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake)

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans divers types de bases de données, y compris des modèles structurés (relationnels), semi-structurés (NoSQL) et basés sur des graphiques (graphiques de connaissances).
• Nice à avoir: vous avez de l'expérience dans l'emballage des solutions de plate-forme de données dans Infrastructure comme Code utilisant des solutions telles que Terraform

• Intérêt et capacité à rester au-dessus des tendances technologiques et architecturales
• Capacité de gérer plusieurs activités dans un environnement et un contexte à haut rythme sans perdre de vue

• Fortes compétences en communication orale et écrite et capacité à exprimer clairement le point de vue et à faire écho aux intervenants techniques et commerciaux

• Expertise technique :

• Modèles conceptuels, logiques et physiques de données
• Modélisation dimensionnelle
• Défaut de données
• Conception de schémas normalisés et dénormalisés pour la charge de travail analytique et opérationnelle et compréhension des outils de modélisation

• Amazone Web Services (AWS)

• Azure

• Conception d'architectures E2E qui équilibrent performance, coût et maintenance

• Utilisation des capacités de GenAI pour optimiser la livraison et l'exploitation

Senior Manager - Cyber Risk Services, Technology & Transformation Location: Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Finding the talent that makes Deloitte unique Do you want to use your cyber expertise, entrepreneurial and innovative mindset to protect companies and society from digital threats, thus making the world a little safer? As the undisputed global leader in cyber security, we work with more than 80% of the Fortune Global 500 companies. Join us as we support the next generation of cyber talent, invest in emerging technologies and drive progress in a dynamic, digital world. How you can make an impact
• By leveraging your professional network, you will be able to recognize potential opportunities for Deloitte to provide assistance in matters related to cybersecurity
• You will apply your knowledge of the client needs and industries to identify relevant cyber risks and develop a tailored strategy on how to best navigate those
• You will support and lead in clients' large-scale transformational projects, applying not only your security expertise but also project management experience and social skills
• You will support leadership in creating fit for purpose cyber strategies by leveraging your experience, market knowledge and our international network of cybersecurity experts
• You will collaborate with interdisciplinary and varied set of team members, client stakeholders and service providers from across the globe
• You will actively create and manage lasting relationships with a diverse set of stakeholders, building on trust as the foundation for business success Who we are looking for
• You have 6+ years of subject matter expertise in cyber strategy or IT risk management with a proven track record in delivering related projects, as a subject matter expert and/or in a project leadership role
• You have 4+ years of experience working in a Big4 Company
• You are a leader with a network of key decision makers and ideally with knowledge of the Romandie (French part of Switzerland) market and ready to develop it
• You hold a Master's degree in information security and/ or another relevant field
• You have proven experience in business development roles (incl. sales or pre-sales), as well as the delivery of complex Cyber projects within a Consulting environment
• Certifications such as CISSP, GSTRT, CISM are considered advantageous
• You are fluent in English, French or German are considered as an advantage Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational, and highly motivated team of Cyber professionals at our offices in Zurich, Basel, Geneva or Lausanne. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programs and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Career at Deloitte Together we are building an inclusive, and open, and culture where you can truly be yourself and where your successes are celebrated. We encourage you to be bold, think big, and challenge the status quo – and we will at your side to support you in developing your career and grow both professionally and personally. Life at Deloitte​ At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges As a Senior Consultant in the Tech M&A cohort of our Deal Transformation practice, you will support corporate and private equity clients in understanding the technology dimension of their most important transactions. Technology has become one of the defining value drivers in M&A—it shapes deal theses, influences valuation, creates integration and separation complexity, and ultimately determines how value is protected and delivered after close. With AI accelerating change across industries, you will help clients assess technology opportunities, risks and disruption while supporting informed deal decisions and long-term value creation. How you will make an impact
• Technology due diligence : Assess technology landscapes, applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, cybersecurity, operating models and technology spend to identify transaction risks and opportunities.
• Technology integrations and carve-outs : Support technology separation and integration planning, including Day 1 readiness, TSA considerations, target-state design and implementation planning.
• Technology strategy and value creation : Analyse technology strategy, AI impact, operating model improvements and value creation opportunities across the transaction lifecycle.
• Technology cost and synergy analysis : Support technology cost assessments, synergy analysis and investment planning while working closely with financial and commercial deal teams.
• Client delivery : Translate complex technology findings into clear analyses and executive-ready recommendations while collaborating with multidisciplinary deal team Who we are looking for
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong interest in technology, M&A and value creation; curiosity for emerging technologies.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to simplify complex technology topics.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree from a leading university.
• Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in M&A, technology strategy, technology transformation, transaction advisory or a related industry role.

jobs.description:
We proudly offer:
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location: Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help our clients solve the biggest challenges of their IT organisation As a (Senior) Consultant at Deloitte, you will join our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists and help organizations to develop strategies and implement systems that build business value and drive performance. We combine in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT projects around the globe, from system replacement to full IT transformation. By enriching us as our newest member, you will gain valuable insights into IT strategy and operating model design, IT architecture, IT business management, IT agility advisory, and IT M&A - we’re looking forward to having you with us! How you can make an impact
• Collaborate with our client’s key technology executives to translate their strategies into effective IT operating models
• Support clients from major Swiss and international organisations to strengthen their IT function and technology capabilities while embracing agile practices
• Make an impact on large-scale IT transformation programmes and shape how the IT function interacts with the business side
• Assess the IT service requirements of our clients, derive tailor-made technology target operating models, and enable business access to IT services Who re we looking for?
• You display strong analytical skills and are able to communicate and present ideas and findings both orally and in writing
• You are well versed in the use of MS Office, demonstrate project management skills, and were able to gain previous experience in IT process management, business partnering, or organisational development
• After graduating in (business) informatics, business administration, or economics, you were able to build up a track record of managing small engagements or parts of larger ones; any ITIL or Agile certifications are a huge plus
• Throughout your career, you have gained professional experience (3 years +) working with technology operating models and bringing about IT transformation in a consulting or corporate environment
• You communicate fluently in English and French or German and look forward to travelling (mainly within Switzerland); additional French skills are an advantage Your team By joining the team in our Zurich office, you will be integrated into a diverse group of like-minded colleagues right from the start. As part of the Technology Strategy & Transformation team, you will work directly with our clients to optimize Technology Organisations and shape the way IT interacts with the business. Our commitment to your professional development translates into an extensive internal and external training programme. Joining us also means benefiting from our in-depth understanding of technology, excellent communication skills and broad business understanding. Look forward to working together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and across the world to introduce the change that will create real impact for their business. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Pieter-Jan at talent@deloitte.ch . *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. © 2026. For information, contact Deloitte AG. All rights reserved. Deloitte AG is an equal opportunities employer.

Arricchendoci come nostro nuovo membro, acquisirai preziose informazioni sulla strategia IT e sul design del modello operativo, l'architettura IT, la gestione aziendale IT, la consulenza per l'agilità IT e l'IT M&A - non vediamo l'ora di averti con noi! • Collabora con i dirigenti della tecnologia chiave del nostro cliente per tradurre le loro strategie in modelli operativi IT efficaci

• Fare un impatto sui programmi di trasformazione IT su larga scala e modellare come la funzione IT interagisce con il lato business
• Valutare i requisiti di servizio IT dei nostri clienti, derivare modelli operativi di tecnologia su misura e consentire l'accesso al business ai servizi IT Chi stiamo cercando?
• Si visualizzano forti capacità analitiche e sono in grado di comunicare e presentare idee e risultati sia per via orale e per iscritto
• Sei ben versato nell'uso di MS Office, dimostrare le competenze di gestione del progetto, e sono stati in grado di acquisire esperienza precedente nella gestione dei processi IT, partner commerciali, o sviluppo organizzativo
• Dopo la laurea in informatica, amministrazione aziendale o economia, è stato in grado di costruire un track record di gestione di piccoli impegni o parti di quelli più grandi; qualsiasi certificazione ITIL o Agile sono un enorme plus
• Durante tutta la tua carriera, hai acquisito esperienza professionale (3 anni +) lavorando con i modelli operativi della tecnologia e portando la trasformazione IT in un ambiente di consulenza o aziendale
• Si comunica fluentemente in inglese e francese o tedesco e non vede l'ora di viaggiare (principalmente all'interno della Svizzera); ulteriori competenze francesi sono un vantaggio Il vostro team Unendo il team nel nostro ufficio di Zurigo, sarete integrati in un gruppo diverso di colleghi simili sin dall'inizio. Nell'ambito del team Technology Strategy & Transformation, lavorerai direttamente con i nostri clienti per ottimizzare le organizzazioni tecnologiche e modellare il modo in cui l'IT interagisce con l'azienda. Il nostro impegno per il vostro sviluppo professionale si traduce in un ampio programma di formazione interno ed esterno. Unirsi a noi significa anche trarre vantaggio dalla nostra profonda comprensione della tecnologia, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e ampia comprensione del business. Non vediamo l'ora di lavorare insieme ad alcune delle più grandi organizzazioni in Svizzera e in tutto il mondo per introdurre il cambiamento che creerà un impatto reale per la loro attività. Vita a Deloitte A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e innescano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori del settore. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità di connettersi, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Come applicare Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Clicca su "apply now" per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Pieter-Jan all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch . * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro - applicare oggi. Non accettiamo richieste da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. © 2026. Per informazioni, contattare Deloitte AG. Tutti i diritti riservati. jobs.description:
We proudly offer: A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment. Open environments where people are free to be themselves. An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Geneva, Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Advise international clients on cutting edge business areas At Deloitte, our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists help organizations develop the strategies and implement the systems that build business value and drive performance. We have the in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT challenges around the globe, everything from system replacement to full IT transformation. By enriching us, you will gain valuable insights into IT Strategy and Operating Model design, IT Architecture, IT Business Management, IT Agility Advisory, and IT M&A - great to have you with us! How you can make an impact
• Work with our client's top technology executives to turn their visions into effective IT solutions
• Lead and support large-scale transformational projects for clients, using your expertise in digital/IT infrastructure, project management, and interpersonal skills
• Use your knowledge and experience, along with our international network of experts, to advise and oversee the development of IT infrastructure that meets our clients needs
• Manage the implementation of technology solutions and coordinate teams with different areas of expertise
• Act as a key facilitator between business and IT to create real change and make a difference for our clients Who are we looking for?
• After graduating in (business) informatics, business administration, or economics, you were able to build up a track record of managing small engagements or parts of larger ones in the context of IT Infrastructure and IT Transformations
• You have strong analytical skills and can effectively communicate technical concepts both verbally and in writing
• You enjoy taking ownership and facing challenges, and your motivation and interest in IT infrastructure and related technologies drive you to stay up-to-date with industry trends and grow your expertise
• You are fluent in English and willing to travel (mostly within Switzerland). Knowledge of French is a plus
• Previous experience as a management consultant is a plus Your team By joining the team in our Zurich office, you will be integrated into a diverse group of like-minded colleagues right from the start. As part of the Technology Strategy & Transformation team, you will work directly with our clients to optimize Technology Organisations and shape the way IT interacts with the business. Our commitment to your professional development translates into an extensive internal and external training programme. Joining us also means benefiting from our in-depth understanding of technology, excellent communication skills and broad business understanding. Look forward to working together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and across the world to introduce the change that will create real impact for their business. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Pieter-Jan at talent@deloitte.ch . *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. Offriamo con orgoglio: un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie. Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse. Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Luogo: Ginevra, Svizzera Percentuale del modello di lavoro: 80-100% Consigli i clienti internazionali sulle aree di business all'avanguardia A Deloitte, i nostri specialisti di strategia e trasformazione tecnologica aiutano le organizzazioni a sviluppare le strategie e implementare i sistemi che costruiscono valore aziendale e prestazioni di azionamento. Abbiamo la conoscenza approfondita e l'esperienza acquisita lavorando su alcune delle sfide IT più complesse in tutto il mondo, tutto, dalla sostituzione del sistema alla completa trasformazione IT. Arricchendoci, otterrai preziose informazioni sul design IT Strategy and Operating Model, su IT Architecture, IT Business Management, IT Agility Advisory e IT M&A - ottimo per averti con noi! Come si può fare un impatto
• Lavorare con i migliori dirigenti tecnologici del nostro cliente per trasformare le loro visioni in soluzioni IT efficaci
• Guidare e sostenere progetti di trasformazione su larga scala per i clienti, utilizzando la vostra competenza nell'infrastruttura digitale/IT, nella gestione dei progetti e nelle competenze interpersonali
• Usa la tua conoscenza e la tua esperienza, insieme alla nostra rete internazionale di esperti, per consigliare e supervisionare lo sviluppo dell'infrastruttura IT che soddisfa le esigenze dei nostri clienti
• Gestire l'implementazione di soluzioni tecnologiche e coordinare team con diverse aree di competenza
• Agire come facilitatore chiave tra business e IT per creare un cambiamento reale e fare la differenza per i nostri clienti Chi stiamo cercando?
• Dopo la laurea in informatica, amministrazione aziendale o economia, si è riusciti a costruire un track record di gestione di piccoli impegni o parti di più grandi nel contesto di Infrastrutture IT e Trasformazioni IT
• Hai forti capacità analitiche e puoi comunicare efficacemente concetti tecnici sia verbalmente che per iscritto
• Ti piace prendere la proprietà e affrontare le sfide, e la tua motivazione e interesse per l'infrastruttura IT e le tecnologie correlate ti spingono a rimanere aggiornato con le tendenze del settore e a crescere la tua esperienza
• Siete fluenti in inglese e disposti a viaggiare (soprattutto in Svizzera). La conoscenza del francese è un plus
• Esperienza precedente come consulente di gestione è un plus Il vostro team Unendo il team nel nostro ufficio di Zurigo, sarete integrati in un gruppo diverso di colleghi di mentalità simile fin dall'inizio. Nell'ambito del team Technology Strategy & Transformation, lavorerai direttamente con i nostri clienti per ottimizzare le organizzazioni tecnologiche e modellare il modo in cui l'IT interagisce con l'azienda. Il nostro impegno per il vostro sviluppo professionale si traduce in un ampio programma di formazione interno ed esterno. Unirsi a noi significa anche trarre vantaggio dalla nostra profonda comprensione della tecnologia, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e ampia comprensione del business. Non vediamo l'ora di lavorare insieme ad alcune delle più grandi organizzazioni in Svizzera e in tutto il mondo per introdurre il cambiamento che creerà un impatto reale per la loro attività. Vita a Deloitte A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e innescano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori del settore. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità di connettersi, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Come applicare Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Clicca su "apply now" per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Pieter-Jan all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch . * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro - applicare oggi. Non accettiamo richieste da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Deloitte AG e Deloitte Consulting AG sono filiali svizzere di Deloitte LLP, società membro della DTTL nel Regno Unito.

Nous offrons fièrement : un lieu de travail sûr et une tolérance zéro pour le harcèlement. Des environnements ouverts où les gens sont libres d'être eux-mêmes. Une communauté inclusive qui croit au respect et au mérite. Lieu : Genève, Suisse Profil de travail Pourcentage : 80-100% Conseiller les clients internationaux sur les secteurs d'activité de pointe Chez Deloitte, nos spécialistes de la stratégie technologique et de la transformation aident les organisations à développer les stratégies et à mettre en œuvre les systèmes qui créent de la valeur commerciale et stimulent les performances. Nous avons les connaissances approfondies et l'expérience acquises en travaillant sur certains des défis informatiques les plus complexes du monde, depuis le remplacement du système jusqu'à la transformation complète des TI. En nous enrichissant, vous gagnerez de précieuses connaissances sur la stratégie et le modèle d'exploitation de la TI, l'architecture de la TI, la gestion d'entreprise de la TI, l'avis d'agilité de la TI et les M&A de la TI - formidable de vous avoir avec nous! Comment faire un impact
• Travailler avec les meilleurs dirigeants technologiques de notre client pour transformer leurs visions en solutions informatiques efficaces
• Diriger et soutenir des projets de transformation à grande échelle pour les clients, en utilisant votre expertise en infrastructure numérique/informatique, gestion de projet et compétences interpersonnelles
• Utilisez vos connaissances et votre expérience, ainsi que notre réseau international d'experts, pour conseiller et superviser le développement d'une infrastructure de TI répondant aux besoins de nos clients.
• Gérer la mise en œuvre de solutions technologiques et coordonner les équipes avec différents domaines d'expertise
• Agir en tant qu'animateur clé entre l'entreprise et la TI pour créer un réel changement et faire une différence pour nos clients Qui cherchons-nous ?
• Après avoir obtenu votre diplôme en informatique (d'affaires), en administration des affaires ou en économie, vous avez été en mesure d'acquérir une expérience de gestion de petits engagements ou de parties d'engagements plus importants dans le contexte de l'infrastructure de TI et des transformations de TI
• Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et pouvez communiquer efficacement des concepts techniques à la fois verbalement et par écrit.
• Vous aimez prendre possession et faire face aux défis, et votre motivation et votre intérêt pour l'infrastructure informatique et les technologies connexes vous poussent à rester au courant des tendances de l'industrie et à développer votre expertise
• Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais et êtes prêt à voyager (surtout en Suisse). La connaissance du français est un plus
• L'expérience antérieure en tant que conseiller en gestion est un atout Votre équipe En vous joignant à l'équipe de notre bureau de Zurich, vous serez intégré dès le départ à un groupe diversifié de collègues partageant les mêmes idées. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Technology Strategy & Transformation, vous travaillerez directement avec nos clients pour optimiser les organisations technologiques et façonner la façon dont l'informatique interagit avec l'entreprise. Notre engagement envers votre perfectionnement professionnel se traduit par un vaste programme de formation interne et externe. Se joindre à nous signifie également bénéficier de notre compréhension approfondie de la technologie, d'excellentes compétences en communication et d'une vaste compréhension des affaires. Nous nous réjouissons à la perspective de collaborer avec certaines des plus grandes organisations de Suisse et du monde entier pour introduire le changement qui créera un impact réel pour leur entreprise. Vie chez Deloitte Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos gens et notre société. Votre expertise, votre expérience et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles façons de relever les défis les plus complexes afin que nous puissions améliorer l'avenir de nos travaux. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous stimule. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez choisir votre impact. En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit et de l'assurance, de la fiscalité et du droit, de la stratégie, du conseil sur les risques et les transactions et de la technologie et de la transformation. Avec près de 3 000 employés sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et des organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs de l'industrie. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et solidaire où vous pouvez être votre meilleur moi et où vous n'arrêterez jamais de grandir. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail flexibles et hybrides, de programmes de bien-être et de programmes parentaux ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de connexion, de collaboration et d'apprentissage. Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'un réseau mondial de personnes partageant les mêmes idées et vouées à faire la différence, que ce soit en s'attaquant au changement climatique ou en améliorant 100 millions d'avenir d'ici 2030. Veuillez cliquer sur « Appliquer maintenant » pour soumettre une demande complète, y compris un CV, une lettre de motivation, des références et des diplômes. jobs.description:
We proudly offer
• A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
• Open environments where people are free to be themselves.
• An inclusive community that believes in respect and merit. Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80% - 100% Help our clients transform their core insurance operations As Senior Consultant / (Senior) Manager, you’ll support our insurance industry clients who are striving for market share and growth to navigate the ongoing wave of market transformation. Between changing customer expectations, the growing influence of technology and AI, and new business models, you’ll help our clients to stay afloat with your fresh perspective and forward-thinking vision. How you can make an impact
• Work closely with our clients at the heart of the business, implementing innovative strategies, crafting the right operating model, integrating core systems, and optimizing their business processes in sales and distribution, marketing, underwriting, operations, customer service and claims
• Provide our clients with your fresh and unique vision on how to build flexible, innovative business and operating models and services that are rooted in a strong foundation
• Support and lead the development of thought leadership, which pinpoints the future of insurance and acts as a value add and door opener to our clients
• Use your skills and day-to-day insights to sculpt the insurance landscape of tomorrow and join Deloitte in our commitment to make an impact that matters Who we are looking for
• You are curious, passionate about learning, able to enrich our projects with your fresh and unique perspective, and able to survey, articulate, and develop solutions to complex problems
• You have a passion for driving topics such as strategy development, operating model redesign, core platform transformation, customer-centric design and process digitisation and cost optimisation in the insurance industry
• You have a university degree with a strong academic record and bring relevant work experience in insurance and/or with a major consulting firm
• You have a solid understanding of the insurance value chain and its core processes, such as sales & distribution, underwriting, policy administration, claims and customer service management
• Good understanding of core insurance platforms is a plus (e.g. Guidewire)
• Fluency in German and English, additional French is a plus Your team You’ll be the newest member of our Insurance Operations & Solutions team – a diverse group of professionals that advises on, designs, implements, and deploys solutions focused on “heart of the business” (e.g., sales and distribution, underwriting, operations and claims) in Property & Casualty, Life and Health Insurance. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Sidorela at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. • La buona comprensione delle piattaforme di assicurazione di base è un plus (ad esempio Guidewire)

Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Se hai domande, contatta Sidorela all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – si applicano oggi. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione.
